title: The Broken Promise
summary: Ha-Jun remembers his elder brother and the night he failed to save him seven years ago. Overcome by agonizing guilt and helplessness, he breaks down in the torrential rain on the university rooftop—unwittingly pressing the razor-sharp demonic feather into his bleeding palm.

panels.action: 17yo Ha-Jun kneeling in the rain holding the glowing obsidian feather close to his chest, steam rising from his soaked navy blazer.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kyun... yeh feather itna jaana-pehchana lag raha hai?

panels.prose_en: 17-year-old Ha-Jun kneeling in the rain holding the glowing obsidian feather close to his chest, steam rising from his soaked navy blazer.
panels.prose_hi: 17 varshiya ha-jun baarish mein ghutnon ke bal baithkar chamakte obsidian pankh ko apni chhati ke paas rakhe hue hai, uske bheege hue navy blazer se bhaap uth rahi hai.

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Ha-Jun's dark brown eyes trembling as radiant violet reflections trigger a deep, buried memory.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's dark brown eyes trembling as radiant violet reflections trigger a deep, buried memory.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki gahre bhure rang ki aankhen chamakdar baingani pratibimbon ke roop mein kamp rahi hain jo ek gahri, dabi hui smriti ko janm deti han.

panels.action: The rain sound distorts into deep sub-bass frequencies as the dark rainy sky warps into a blurry monochrome vignette.
panels.prose_en: The rain sound distorts into deep sub-bass frequencies as the dark rainy sky warps into a blurry monochrome vignette.
panels.prose_hi: Barish ki dhwani gahri up-bas aavrittiyon mein vikrit ho jaati hai kyonki andhera barsati aakash dhundhale monochrome vignet mein badal jata hai.

panels.action: Flashback 7 years ago: A narrow, decaying industrial alleyway at midnight in torrential rain, rusted fire escapes and flickering yellow streetlights.

dialogue.text: Saat saal pehle... us raat bhi aisi hi baarish thi.

panels.prose_en: A narrow, decaying industrial alleyway at midnight in torrential rain, rusted fire escapes and flickering yellow streetlights.
panels.prose_hi: Aadhi raat ko musladhar baarish mein ek sankari, khastahal audyogik gali, jung lagi aag aur timtimati pili street liten.

panels.action: 10-year-old young Ha-Jun cowering behind a rusted metal dumpster, trembling violently in soaked oversized clothes.
panels.prose_en: 10-year-old young Ha-Jun cowering behind a rusted metal dumpster, trembling violently in soaked oversized clothes.
panels.prose_hi: 10 varshiya yuva ha-jun jung lage dhatu ke koodedaan ke peeche bheege hue bade kapdon mein buri tarah kamp raha tha.

panels.action: Young elder brother Kang Tae-Jun (16yo, tall, black trench coat, sharp jawline) stepping firmly between little Ha-Jun and the alley entrance.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: Darna mat, Ha-Jun. Main hoon na.

panels.prose_en: Young elder brother Kang Tae-Jun (16yo, tall, black trench coat, sharp jawline) stepping firmly between little Ha-Jun and the alley entrance.
panels.prose_hi: Yuva bada bhai kang taaye-jun (16 varshiy, lamba, kala trench kot, nukila jabada) chhote ha-jun aur gali ke pravesh dwar ke beech majbuti se kadam rakh raha hai.

panels.action: Tae-Jun turning his head back over his shoulder with a gentle, reassuring smile, despite blood dripping from a cut on his brow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: Apni aankhein band kar lo. Sab theek ho jayega.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun turning his head back over his shoulder with a gentle, reassuring smile, despite blood dripping from a cut on his brow.
panels.prose_hi: Mathe par chot ke karan khoon tapakne ke bavjud, taaye-jun ne ek saumya, aashvast muskan ke saath apna sir apne kandhe par peeche ghumaya.

panels.action: Across the dark flooded alley, multiple shadowy demonic beasts with glowing crimson eyes and razor claws emerge from swirling black mist.
panels.prose_en: Across the dark flooded alley, multiple shadowy demonic beasts with glowing crimson eyes and razor claws emerge from swirling black mist.
panels.prose_hi: Andheri baadh wali gali ke par, chamakti lal aankhon aur ustare ke panjon ke saath kai chhayadar rakshasi janwar ghumte kale kohre se bahar nikalte han.

panels.action: A monstrous demonic beast lunges forward with jagged claws tearing through the brick walls of the alley.
panels.prose_en: A monstrous demonic beast lunges forward with jagged claws tearing through the brick walls of the alley.
panels.prose_hi: Ek rakshasi janwar gali ki int ki diwaron ko chirate hue dantedar panjon ke saath aage badhta hai.

panels.action: Tae-Jun raising his bare hand, manifesting a glowing dark-blue and violet demonic energy barrier that deflects the beast's attack.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun raising his bare hand, manifesting a glowing dark-blue and violet demonic energy barrier that deflects the beast's attack.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne apne nange haath ko upar uthaya, ek chamakdar gahre-nile aur baingani rakshasi urja avrodh ko prakat kiya jo janwar ke hamle ko rok deta hai.

panels.action: Tae-Jun gritting his teeth in strain as fine cracks spiderweb across the magical barrier under crushing demonic force.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun gritting his teeth in strain as fine cracks spiderweb across the magical barrier under crushing demonic force.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apne daanton ko jor se peeste hue rakshasi shakti ke tahat jaadui badha ke paar makdi ke jale ko tod deta hai.

panels.action: Little Ha-Jun peeking through his trembling, rain-soaked fingers behind the dumpster, pupils shrunk in sheer terror.

dialogue.speaker: young_hajun
dialogue.text: M-Mujhe kuch karna hoga... lekin mere pair hil nahi rahe...!

panels.prose_en: Little Ha-Jun peeking through his trembling, rain-soaked fingers behind the dumpster, pupils shrunk in sheer terror.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota ha-jun koodedaan ke peeche apni compati, baarish se bheegi hui ungaliyon se jhaank raha hai, putliyan behad dar se sikud gai han.

panels.action: Tae-Jun shouting back with fierce desperation, hair whipped by rain and mana shockwaves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: BHAAGO, HA-JUN! PEECHE MAT DEKHNA! MUJHSE VAADA KARO KI TUM JIYOGE!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun shouting back with fierce desperation, hair whipped by rain and mana shockwaves.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun bhayankar hatasha ke saath chilla raha hai, baarish ke karan uske bal jhad gaye hain aur man ko jhatka lag raha hai.

panels.action: A jagged black demonic spear pierces through Tae-Jun's shoulder from behind in a high-contrast black-and-crimson silhouette.
panels.prose_en: A jagged black demonic spear pierces through Tae-Jun's shoulder from behind in a high-contrast black-and-crimson silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dantedar kala rakshasi bhala ek ucch-viparit kale aur lal rang ke silhut mein taaye-jun ke kandhe ko peeche se chhedata hai.

panels.action: Tae-Jun's bloodied hand slipping away from little Ha-Jun's outstretched reaching fingers into a swirling void rift.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's bloodied hand slipping away from little Ha-Jun's outstretched reaching fingers into a swirling void rift.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ka khoon se sana haath chhote ha-jun ki faili hui ungaliyon se fisalkar ek ghumte hue shunya daraar mein pahunch gaya.

panels.action: The black rift collapses violently into a pinprick of light, sucking the demonic beasts and Tae-Jun away into complete silence.
panels.prose_en: The black rift collapses violently into a pinprick of light, sucking the demonic beasts and Tae-Jun away into complete silence.
panels.prose_hi: Kali daraar hinsak roop se prakash ki chubhan mein dhah jaati hai, rakshasi janvaron aur taaye-jun ko puri tarah se shant kar deti hai.

panels.action: Harsh snap back to present day: Extreme close-up of 17yo Ha-Jun's eye dilating in visceral panic on the cold wet rooftop floor.
panels.prose_en: Harsh snap back to present day: Extreme close-up of 17-year-old Ha-Jun's eye dilating in visceral panic on the cold wet rooftop floor.
panels.prose_hi: Vartaman samay ki kathor tasweer: chhat ke thande, gile farsh par 17 varshiya ha-jun ki aantein ghabrahat mein failti hui behad nazdeek se dikhai gain.

panels.action: Ha-Jun collapsing forward onto both hands and knees into a rain puddle, water splashing heavily over his battered uniform.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun collapsing forward onto both hands and knees into a rain puddle, water splashing heavily over his battered uniform.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun donon hathon aur ghutnon ke bal aage ki or ek baarish ke pokhar mein gir gaya, uski fati hui vardi par pani ke tej chhinte pad rahe the.

panels.action: Vast panoramic overhead view of the lonely, drenched teenager on the sprawling concrete university rooftop surrounded by towering skyscrapers.

dialogue.text: Us raat ke baad se... duniya ke liye wo gayab ho gaya.

panels.prose_en: Vast panoramic overhead view of the lonely, drenched teenager on the sprawling concrete university rooftop surrounded by towering skyscrapers.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal gaganchumbi imaaraton se ghire vishal concrete vishwavidyalaya ki chhat par akele, bheege hue kishore ka vishal manoram drishya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clutching his drenched black hair with his left hand, his right hand still desperately grasping Kuro's glowing feather.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Lekin sach toh yeh hai... maine unhe chhod diya tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutching his drenched black hair with his left hand, his right hand still desperately grasping Kuro's glowing feather.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apne bheege kale baalon ko apne baen haath se pakad rakha hai, uska dahina haath abhi bhi utsukta se kuro ke chamakte pankh ko pakad raha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's face tilted downward, hot tears streaming down his bruised cheeks, mouth wide in an agonizing, silent sob amidst heavy rainfall.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN BHAAG GAYA THA! MAIN ITNA KAMZOR THA...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's face tilted downward, hot tears streaming down his bruised cheeks, mouth wide in an agonizing, silent sob amidst heavy rainfall.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka chehra neeche ki or jhuka hua tha, uske chotil gaalon se garm aansu bah rahe the, bhari baarish ke beech uska muh pidadayak, khamosh siskiyon mein chauda tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slamming his left scraped fist hard into the wet concrete, sending rainwater spraying and hairline cracks radiating outward.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slamming his left scraped fist hard into the wet concrete, sending rainwater spraying and hairline cracks radiating outward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apni bayin khurchi hui mutthi ko gile concrete mein jor se patak diya, jisse baarish ka pani fail gaya aur hairline ki dararen bahar ki or fail gain.

panels.action: In his right palm, Kuro's feather begins vibrating and pulsing with an intense, rhythmic crimson-violet heartbeat glow.
panels.prose_en: In his right palm, Kuro's feather begins vibrating and pulsing with an intense, rhythmic crimson-violet heartbeat glow.
panels.prose_hi: Uski dahini hatheli men, kuro ka pankh ek teevra, laybaddh crimson-bangni dil ki dhadkan ki chamak ke saath hilna aur spandit hona shuru kar deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clenching his right fist with furious intensity around the feather, heedless of the sharp obsidian quill pressing deep into his flesh.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar mere paas taqat hoti... toh kya bhaiya aaj yahan hote?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clenching his right fist with furious intensity around the feather, heedless of the sharp obsidian quill pressing deep into his flesh.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne pankh ke charon or tivra tivrata se apni dahini mutthi bheench lee hai, is baat ki parvah kiye bina ki tej obsidian kalam uske shareer mein gahrai tak ja rahi hai.

panels.action: The razor-sharp obsidian tip of the feather's quill punctures Ha-Jun's pale palm. A thick, vibrant droplet of scarlet blood wells up.
panels.prose_en: The razor-sharp obsidian tip of the feather's quill punctures Ha-Jun's pale palm. A thick, vibrant droplet of scarlet blood wells up.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh ki kalam ki ustra-nukili obsidian nok ha-jun ki pili hatheli ko chhed deti hai. lal rang ke rakt ki ek moti, jeevant boond ubhar aati hai.

panels.action: The scarlet droplet touches the glowing violet barb of Kuro's feather. Time seems to slow to a standstill.

dialogue.text: Ek lahu ka qatra... aur sadiyon purana bandhan toot gaya.

panels.prose_en: The scarlet droplet touches the glowing violet barb of Kuro's feather. Time seems to slow to a standstill.
panels.prose_hi: Lal rang ki boond kuro ke pankh ki chamakti baingani patti ko chhuti hai. aisa lagta hai jaise samay dheema ho gaya hai.

panels.action: The scarlet blood does not wash away in the rain; it is drawn into the feather's veins, illuminating the black plumage with glowing red and violet circuits.
panels.prose_en: The scarlet blood does not wash away in the rain; it is drawn into the feather's veins, illuminating the black plumage with glowing red and violet circuits.
panels.prose_hi: Lal rang ka khoon baarish mein nahin dhulta; yah pankh ki nason mein khincha jata hai, jo chamakdar lal aur baingani circuit ke saath kale pankh ko roshan karta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun gasps, freezing in shock as burning supernatural heat surges directly from the feather into his wrist and forearm veins.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh kya hai...?! Mere haath ke andar...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gasps, freezing in shock as burning supernatural heat surges directly from the feather into his wrist and forearm veins.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hanfta hai, sadme mein jam jata hai kyonki jalti hui alaukik garmi pankh se sidhe uski kalai aur baanh ki nason mein pravahit hoti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun staring wide-eyed at his right arm as black and violet demonic veins crawl beneath his skin, emitting white cleansing steam.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun staring wide-eyed at his right arm as black and violet demonic veins crawl beneath his skin, emitting white cleansing steam.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni dahini bhuja ko badi-badi aankhon se dekh raha hai, uski tvacha ke neeche kali aur baingani rakshasi nasen reng rahi han, jisse safed safai wali bhaap nikal rahi hai.

panels.action: Grand climactic shot: Storm clouds swirl into a gigantic vortex directly above Ha-Jun. Violet lightning forks across the sky as a ghostly demonic eye opens within the clouds.

dialogue.text: AKHIR KAAR... SOVEREIGN KA KHOON JAAG UTHTA HAI.

panels.prose_en: Grand climactic shot: Storm clouds swirl into a gigantic vortex directly above Ha-Jun. Violet lightning forks across the sky as a ghostly demonic eye opens within the clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Grand climactic shot: toofan ke badal sidhe ha-jun ke upar ek vishal bhanwar mein ghumte han. jaise hi baadalon ke bhitar ek bhutiya rakshasi aankh khulti hai, baingani bijli aakash mein ghumti hai.
